definitions.rate: TRIR = 200000 * reported recordable cases / reported hours; not a national estimate.
definitions.population: Default plausibility-screen-passing filings, including all peer cells regardless of publishability.
definitions.matched: NAICS-3 by employee-size cells present in both years; membership can change within a cell.
definitions.weights: Each matched cell's hours divided by total matched hours in its own year.
definitions.within_effect: Sum of average of the two exposure weights times change in cell rate.
definitions.composition_effect: Sum of average of the two cell rates times change in exposure weight.
definitions.support_residual: Full-population change minus common-support change; exact additive reconciliation.
definitions.fixed_weights: Both earlier-year and later-year weights reported separately; the symmetric within effect averages them.
definitions.suspect_selection: Retrospective exploratory audit of 2023: rank its default-screen-passing filings by reported hours, without using case counts in that ranking. The choice to investigate 2023 is not preregistered.
definitions.exclusions: Sensitivity scenarios, not corrected rates, validated error classifications, or estimates of true hours.
definitions.joint_scaling: Multiplying hours and employees by the same positive constant leaves hours per employee unchanged.

limitations: Descriptive administrative filings, not a probability sample or a causal study.
Within-cell differences include changing establishments, reporting practices and unmeasured mix; they are not same-site safety changes.
Same establishment_id is a linkage hint, not verified physical identity. No institution names are needed for this audit.
Exclusion sensitivity cannot identify which fields are wrong or recover their true values.
Threshold stability does not establish absolute-scale validity: every tested bound acts on the same ratio.
Symmetric decomposition is an accounting convention; earlier- and later-weight counterfactuals can differ materially.
No uncertainty intervals or national extrapolation are claimed; observed snapshots and their deterministic sensitivity are reported.

influence_audit.rule: For each adjacent-year comparison, review every screened filing whose single deletion reverses the sign. Apply identically to both years. Keep observations pending review; influence is not an error classification.
influence_audit.rule_status: Deterministic prospective operational rule, applied retrospectively here; not historically preregistered.

scale_invariance.conditions: A passing row has E>=1, H>0, finite values and valid case fields. Scale E and H by the same a>=1, keeping cases fixed and products finite.
scale_invariance.invariant: (a*H)/(a*E) = H/E. All hours-per-employee thresholds and unchanged case flags retain their verdict.
scale_invariance.consequence: In real-number arithmetic, R(a) tends to zero as a grows. Ratio-screen acceptance alone supplies no lower bound on the pooled rate.
scale_invariance.qualification: This theorem describes a blind spot, not the actual mechanism behind any reported field.

influence_audit.concentration_definition: Hours HHI is sum of squared filing exposure shares. Its reciprocal is the number of equally weighted filings with the same concentration; it is not an effective statistical sample size or uncertainty estimate.
influence_audit.accounting_definition: Numerator and denominator effects average both orders of removal and add to the joint rate change. Single-input changes are mathematical scenarios, not repaired filings.
